content: Consequently, while the recent gains signal a resumption of growth, the magnitude of the recovery is magnified by the contrasting underperformance of the preceding year [44][45] . The resurgence in mining activity has not been uniform across all mineral categories, reflecting underlying sector-specific disparities that directly influence targeted logistics demand. The recovery has been highlighted as particularly strong within the precious metals segments, most notably in the gold and platinum sectors [42] .
